description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60082702), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EC%9D%B4-%EC%A1%B0%EA%B1%B4%EC%9E%85%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/3641)

A mother who abandoned her as soon as she gave birth and ran away, then clung to her in pursuit of an inheritance. A company that works as a non-regular worker and demands that he bring his wife's clothes.  
Even the company colleagues who know the truth but turn a blind eye for fear of sparks. Doain Hogu is used and abandoned by both real and fake families.

Han Tae-seo, managing director of the Han River Group, came to Do-a-in.

“I need 1% of what you have.”

They said they would accept any condition for my share... "My condition is marriage."

It is a contract marriage to have what each other needs for Do Ah-in to restore honor and Han Tae-seo to take the position of leader.

"Let's get married."  
Can the two people fall into a place where they don't know what traps await them, can they safely finish this contract marriage?
